reference: GCF_049306965.1; 26 source sequence records for mapping, 25 nuclear chromosomes for satellite annotation
data: Six adult TL forebrain modBAM samples, PRJEB108899, ERR16782314–ERR16782319
formal_scope: Family-selected and independently anchored estimates are separate from the all-read regional track estimand in regional_methylation.json.
prefilter: at least one reference-exclusive25 or31mer from either family anywhere on read; no modification/CpG selection; every final word-qualified read is a logical subset

family_sensitivity.limit: lower fraction.5 not validated because secondary labels used.8; no scientific use of that diagnostic grid

CpG_main: actual read CG with both bases in adjacent primary matched reference positions inside the same unambiguous family segment; TU referenceCG not required for family calls; required separately for site-coordinate estimates

base_quality.basis: existing real-pilot preserved-quality/context checks; technical Q filter, not biological family admission

modified_calls.logic: C/m/h unique maximal probability across quantization intervals; selected state lower bound>=threshold; ties/unknown/low confidence excluded from valid-call denominator
modified_calls.implicit: exact Dorado build sharedC mask threshold12: m,h in[0,12/256), canonical in(232/256,1]; never exact zero
modified_calls.explicit: ML byte b probability in[b/256,(b+1)/256); canonical complement interval
modified_calls.primary_fraction: 5mC classified calls/(canonical+5mC+5hmC valid calls);5hmC separate, same denominator
modified_calls.supplement: mean modification-probability interval over all evaluable CpGs, distinct from classified fraction; not a confidence interval
modified_calls.threshold_basis: same model-confidence criterion for families and samples;0.8 is an analyst-frozen80%minimum, evaluated with0.5/0.9/0.95; not claimed as a universal published default or a user-selected numeric setting

local_anchor.required: continuous noncatalog matched segment>=200bp (external flank or internal noncatalog interruption); existing MAPQ20lead; expected anchor covered>=.8; all TU competing loci searched, correct accession/strand; parent high-scoring alignments must preserve anchor placement; no supplementary/conflicting/capped mapping
local_anchor.scope: local reference-position association only; no whole-array verification

estimands: each individual separate; reads/CpG observations are not biological replicates; family call-weighted statistics not locus-equal, not population abundance; reference/quality/word/cap filters define observable subset
regional_tracks: See metadata/regional_methylation.json; data/regional_methylation/per_run contains current regional CpG counts; data/array_study/chromosome_methylation_tracks retains the anchored collection.
